reuse.why: Fintegra reuses bank lookup, account linking and synchronization, while all providers share the new link guard.

duplication.why: The replacement path copies unlinkAccount's local reset, and the Fintegra downloader repeats the existing authenticated transaction-download workflow.

placement.why: The changes follow existing module boundaries, although routing Fintegra through a SimpleFin-named handler obscures the shared linking responsibility.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested linking policies, Fintegra integration and supporting tests.

maintainability.why: Centralized guards improve ownership, but duplicated unlink state and a provider-specific handler serving multiple providers leave avoidable maintenance coupling.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six registered linking handlers use guardBankAccountLink; unlinkAccount includes remote removal and therefore cannot directly serve the local-only replacement operation.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the authentication, POST, error handling and response mapping already present in downloadAkahuTransactions and downloadPluggyAiTransactions.

abstraction_drift.where: The shared linking interface gains replaceExistingLink and provider; linkSimpleFinAccount gains an orgDomain shape check to accommodate Fintegra, while every registered linking entry point uses the shared guard.
